name: orbrey-ai-marketplace
description: Orbrey AI Marketplace — household automation skills, agents, and commands that run on top of the orbrey-mcp Cloudflare Worker (meal planning, grocery, chores, routines, calendar, rewards).

plugins.name: orbrey-ai
plugins.description: 12 skills + 3 agents + 6 commands for running an Orbrey household — meal planning, grocery, chores, routines, family scheduling, calendar conflicts, and rewards. Includes kitchen-concierge, which places real grocery orders through your own Chrome session behind a code-enforced spend ceiling. Connects to the orbrey-mcp Cloudflare Worker over HTTP with OAuth handled by Claude Code.
